root_cause.text: The do_procmap_query() function jumps to a common error label (out) that performs mmput() after the build ID size check, but due to a prior code reorganization (commit b5cbacd7f86f), that check now occurs after mmput() has already been called, causing a double decrement of the mm reference count.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "After recent changes this condition happens later, after we unlocked mmap_lock/per-VMA lock and did mmput(), so original goto out is now wrong and will double-mmput() mm_struct." The patch fixes this by replacing `goto out;` with `goto out_file;` which skips the `mmput()` and `query_vma_teardown()` calls.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit moves build_id parsing after mmput(), but when the build_id size check fails (karg.build_id_size < build_id_sz), the code jumps to 'out' label which calls mmput(mm) again after it was already called in the main path. This causes a double decrement of the mm reference count, introducing the vulnerability. No fix is present for this double mmput.
